Definition: Tsicha, the name of two Nethinim
BiblicalUsage: Ziha is one of the Nethinim, the temple servants who returned from Babylon. In Ezra 2:43, the children of Ziha. The fuller story is told on the Ziha profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Ziha is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
